notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Barrenton Medic has a power of two or greater, it will also get infinite +1/+1 counters.
